worksheets.explanation: Proper nouns are special names for people and pets. They always start with a capital letter. Common nouns name any person or animal, like 'boy' or 'dog'. Proper nouns name a particular one, like 'Sam' or 'Rex'.
examples: My teacher is Mrs Patel.
My best friend is called Ben.
Our dog is named Rex.
I have a cat called Whiskers.
My little sister is called Ivy.
Our class hamster is called Nibbles.
My grandad's name is Mr Owusu.
